classification: Development pilot with known adapter and operational defects

issues.detail: R0 omitted the shared validation/user-evidence adapter, causing valid proposals and derived calculations to be penalized for missing provenance. Original generations and scores are retained; this is not evidence that the production baseline cannot make those proposals.

Both query backend fields were exposed in one grammar. Wren repeatedly selected custom plans that the backend gate correctly rejected. A later development version exposes only the permitted backend schema and actual typed Wren columns.

Three early route requests expired during manual-to-continuous dispatcher transition. These are harness errors, not established provider outages. The continuously logged319requests all returnedHTTP200.

interpretation: Complete unchanged data proves measurement coverage/integrity only. These known defects make this pilot unsuitable for selecting an architecture. No held-out questions were used to make the fixes.
